$comment: [X4.12] Vercel MCP attach spec. Tier-2 VERIFIED-PUBLISHER (publisher `vercel` — official Vercel MCP server, com.vercel namespace; X1.14 evidence). Completes the 12 verified-publisher core (X4.1–X4.12). Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). HOSTED http-sse remote endpoint (no local package), OAuth auth + public docs tools. CC0-1.0.
title: Vercel Projects & Deployments
description: Search Vercel docs and manage teams, projects, deployments, and logs via the official hosted Vercel MCP server.

auth.recipe: no static credential — the AI client performs an interactive OAuth sign-in to your Vercel account on first use (granting the same access as your user); the documentation tools work without authentication.

sample_tools.name: search_documentation
sample_tools.summary: Search Vercel documentation for a topic (public, no auth).

sample_tools.name: list_teams
sample_tools.summary: List the teams the authenticated user belongs to.

sample_tools.name: list_projects
sample_tools.summary: List Vercel projects for a team.

sample_tools.name: get_project
sample_tools.summary: Get details for a project — framework, domains, and latest deployment.

sample_tools.name: list_deployments
sample_tools.summary: List a project's deployments with state and target.

sample_tools.name: get_deployment_build_logs
sample_tools.summary: Get a deployment's build logs to investigate failures.

sample_tools.name: get_runtime_logs
sample_tools.summary: Get runtime logs (console output, errors) for a project or deployment.

known_limitations: Authenticates via interactive OAuth — the AI client signs in to your Vercel account and gains the same access as your user; the public documentation tools work without auth.
Hosted remote endpoint (https://mcp.vercel.com) — requires outbound network access; no local subprocess. Vercel only approves a reviewed list of MCP clients.
Some tools take real-world actions — `buy_domain` purchases a domain (charges your account) and `deploy_to_vercel` ships a deployment; enable human confirmation before executing.
Tool access mirrors your Vercel permissions; team-scoped tools require a teamId (find it via list_teams or .vercel/project.json).

Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no tool matches destructive name patterns (destructive_tools is empty); high-impact tools (buy_domain, deploy_to_vercel, toolbar edits) are gated by the trust policy's allowDestructive:false and per-call confirmation.

client_install.claude_desktop: Claude CLI: `claude mcp add --transport http vercel https://mcp.vercel.com`, then run `/mcp` to complete the OAuth sign-in.
client_install.cursor: Add to ~/.cursor/mcp.json as `vercel`: { url: https://mcp.vercel.com }; click the `Needs login` prompt to authorize.
client_install.vscode: Run `MCP: Add Server` → HTTP, URL `https://mcp.vercel.com`, name `Vercel` (VS Code with Copilot); authorize via OAuth on first start.
